title: Evan Vanderveer - Customers are the North Star
description:
🎙 Welcome to The Business Brew! 
Evan Vanderveer of Vanshap Capital joins The Brew to discuss investing in businesses built around a deep commitment to their customers. His approach combines on-the-ground research, a focus on founder-led cultures, and the willingness to hold a concentrated portfolio through uncertainty. We explore how that philosophy translates into investment decisions—and how to distinguish an exceptional business from an exceptional investment. 

The central tension is how to balance conviction in management and long-term growth with discipline around valuation, risk, and evidence that challenges the thesis. 

Tune in for a conversation about looking beyond the financial statements while remaining accountable to what shareholders ultimately earn.

BIOGRAPHY


 Evan Vanderveer is a Managing Partner of ⁠ Vanshap Capital⁠, which he co-founded with David Shapiro in partnership with ⁠Markel Group⁠ (NYSE: MKL) in 2012. Prior to Vanshap, Evan was an Investment Analyst at Aegis Financial Corporation where he helped expand idea generation to include international equities. Evan received a Bachelor of Business Administration degree with a concentration in finance from The George Washington University.
